geographical_contract: One England and Wales benchmark and seven publisher-defined, disjoint regional groups; residual unmapped records retained separately.

aggregation_audit.csv.national_records: Original England and Wales transactions_recorded count
aggregation_audit.csv.mapped_regional_records: Sum of the seven declared regional-group counts
aggregation_audit.csv.unmapped_records: Original coverage-table residual; not an estimate of unregistered sales
aggregation_audit.csv.unsafe_sum_of_all_rows: Deliberately invalid national plus regional sum, for demonstration only
aggregation_audit.csv.overstatement_pct: 100 times overstatement_records divided by national_records; six decimals; blank if denominator zero
